symptom: A successful native lane canvas write is shown as a generic operation with no user-facing effect summary.
direct_cause: The display resolves only legacy aliases, and the lane view model drops tool arguments before choosing labels and never supplies the existing summary field.
class_root: Tool display must derive capability identity and effect text from the current model descriptor plus actual arguments.
affected_population: Native lane canvas and storyboard tools
internal_only_reason: The mapping of Nomi user input and failure visibility is a domain invariant; installed pi 0.85.1 public APIs are inspected in the stage 4 plan.
invariants: Current model descriptors and operation arguments determine labels and action icons.
Successful calls retain their intended effect summary; failures show failure information and refusals do not claim a successful effect.
generality_proof: The shared model descriptor resolver covers every internal tool and falls back only to separately registered external surface aliases; UI text is localized at the existing display owner.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve tool names and operation-specific capability from the existing registration.
Pass actual arguments to the existing label/summary owner and preserve failure/refusal semantics.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Registry-derived test lists every internal tool and rejects generic labels.
Actual arguments choose canvas/read/delete labels and summaries; failure and refusal replace effect text.
read_full_text uses the current document.read capability rather than substring heuristics.

recurrence.reason: Every current or future model name can diverge from its external alias.
same_class_scan: Scanned the full modelFacingToolSpecs internal list
Read label, summary, preview and action-family consumers
Real Electron editing walk reproduced missing canvas effect text

prevention.invariant: Display identity derives from actual capability descriptors.
prevention.failure_mode: A newly unlabelled tool fails the registry-derived display test.
prevention.strategy: Use one resolver for actual model names and registered external aliases.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace legacy-only lookup and name-only label dispatch; no second display store.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency change is needed to bind Nomi workspace ownership.

migration: Existing transcripts are projected through the corrected display; no history files are rewritten.
residual_risks: Editing and real-user Electron walks must revalidate the displayed effects and unchanged write authority.

invariant_owner_layer.why: This is the shared mapping from ordered lane facts to existing v4 tool receipts.
